testAdvancedCollectionDefaultsOff.desc: Checks that with an empty config, the interval is 0 and all advanced tracking is disabled.

testRecoveryTrackingIsExplicit.desc: Checks that recoveryTrackingEnabled must be explicitly set to true.

testGameplayExitTrackingIsExplicit.desc: Checks that gameplayExitTrackingEnabled must be explicitly set to true.

testShaderGenerationTrackingIsExplicit.desc: Checks that shaderGenerationTrackingEnabled must be explicitly set to true.

testDetailedMetricsAreExplicit.desc: Checks that sceneComplexityTrackingEnabled and renderTimingTrackingEnabled must be explicitly enabled.

testLevelFilterBecomesLookup.desc: Checks that the levels list becomes a lookup table name -> true.

testDipSettingsAreClamped.desc: Checks that out-of-range dip thresholds are brought back within their bounds.
